snippet.title: Claire Darksage and the Accursed Objects CE | Hidden Object Games | IPlay
snippet.description:
A rift between realms has opened, releasing a torrent of cursed relics into a vulnerable kingdom. Every relic emanates a vibrant glow or a sinister darkness, siphoning vitality and unleashing chaos. Even the mightiest of mages find themselves unable to escape their hold. Yet, a glimmer of hope persists: Claire Darksage, the audacious bounty hunter and the final Elemental Harmonizer, endowed with the extraordinary ability to harmonize conflicting forces.

Embark on an exhilarating adventure with Claire as she navigates through scorching deserts, mystical forests, icy tundras, and treacherous volcanic landscapes. Engage in epic confrontations with formidable adversaries through tactical card battles, outsmart clever minstrels in perplexing challenges, and unveil long-lost mysteries concealed within the depths of ancient ruins. Unite a vibrant array of allies and determine the destiny of a kingdom on the brink of collapse.

Experience the adventure like never before with this Collector's Edition, featuring exclusive missions, hidden scenes, achievements, and bonus content that enrich the lore and challenge your skills. Can you conquer the elements and break the curse before time slips away?


Discover a world brimming with intrigue and adventure

- Explore 20 meticulously crafted Hidden Object scenes, each teeming with cursed relics that dance between light and shadow.
- Engage in strategic battles, utilizing innovative card mechanics to outsmart formidable foes.
- Immerse yourself in an epic fantasy narrative, rich with unexpected twists, hidden secrets, and unforgettable characters.
- Test your skills with challenging minigames and take on the Minstrels' Challenge for a delightful variety of clever gameplay.
- Darksage Temple: Enhance your skills and gather formidable cards
- Uncover Golden Skulls and Beast Eyes: Find hidden collectibles and reap exciting rewards
- Engaging puzzles that can be replayed, with customizable difficulty settings for a personalized adventure


Exclusive Collector's Edition Discover the captivating features that await you

- Embark on the Tower of Echoes mission, complete with 8 bonus Hidden Object scenes
- Dive into exclusive minigames and secret challenges, unique to this edition
- Adorn your space with 7 custom wallpapers showcasing breathtaking fantasy artwork
- Unlock 20 achievements to proudly display your skills and mastery
- The Coliseum: Take on additional challenges and showcase your might
- Discover a hidden object scene and a secret battle - will you find them?
